parsed.public_message: Orange: quiet again. Army stays on Little Hill, rider stays south of z600. Pact reaffirmed: neutral to all, no first strike through t450, then a full public turn of notice before any hostilities. We are not climbing toward the Heights or the West Plateau, and nothing of ours is in Blue's x440-500 lane.

private_messages.GPT: Quiet on my side; nothing has crossed z600. I'm easing my rider to ~(678,584), still south of the line, only to keep a clean view of the boundary - no change in posture. For your planning: White's stated corridor (x520-660, due south off the crest) ends on your plain, and Blue's lane (x440-500, z640-720) opens t275-300 on your west flank. Our line holds until we revisit it ~t425 as agreed.
private_messages.Grok: Nothing is climbing toward the Heights from the south; my army is still on Little Hill and won't head your way. From my rider: Green's main body, hero included, is still parked at ~(680,620), right at the foot of your x520-660 corridor, and it is archer-heavy. No sign of it moving north yet; I'll tell you at once if that changes. Anything you can see of Blue on the West Plateau?
private_messages.Gemini: Thanks for the White cavalry fix. Green's main body hasn't moved: still ~(680,623) with Ptolemy, and it is archer-heavy. Once you're down in x440-500, z640-720 you'll be its western neighbour at about 200 m. My rider stays south of z600 and nothing of mine will be in your lane. If you get eyes on White's main body on the crest, I'd value a heads-up.

parsed.explanation: Another quiet turn for Orange: the main army stays hidden on Little Hill, safe from the ring until about t450, while the lone rider edges east to recount Green's centre army after its elephants and spearmen slipped out of view. Orange stays neutral to all and keeps the pact, but trades sightings so that White and Blue both register that Green's archer-heavy army sits at the end of their descent routes.
